summary: Tested requested backend and end-to-end flows against the public preview. Core timetable generation/PDF, admission/batch roster/move, teacher student scope, finance PDFs, default Indian salary calculation, Razorpay test orders, complaint attachment/audit UI, legal pages, and all three role logins worked. Blocking gaps remain in the Principal AI Insights UI, complaint routing/privacy and status validation, timetable all-batches rendering, and required cookie/CORS auth controls.

critical.issue: A student complaint routed to 'both' is returned to every teacher in the institute, not only the student's assigned/class teacher. Reproduced with teacher2 reading a complaint for teacher1's batch.
Status is not validated: PUT with status='deleted' returns 200, persists it, and appends it to the audit trail although only pending/under_review/resolved are allowed.
Successful login does not set an application access_token HttpOnly cookie; the only Set-Cookie observed is the edge-provider __cf_bm cookie.
Credentialed CORS playbook requirement fails: allow_credentials is false and no explicit credentialed origin is returned.

minor.issue: The statutory 45%-Basic and 40/50%-of-Basic HRA calculation is bypassed when salary_components exist. Anita's generated salary used Basic 30000/HRA 8000 rather than the requested legal auto-breakdown; default, unconfigured teachers calculate correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: The required AI Insights panel is entirely absent; data-testid='ai-insights-panel' is not rendered and Dashboard.jsx never calls /dashboard/insights.
The grid hardcodes all six DAYS and six SLOTS instead of the configured generation days/periods. A five-day generation still displayed an empty Saturday column.
Opening timetable, student, batch, and complaint dialogs repeatedly logs missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby accessibility warnings.

integration_issues.issue: Generation returned 120 persisted slots, but the default All Batches grid indexes entries only by day+slot, so entries from different batches overwrite one another and only one batch is shown per cell. Users must manually filter each batch to see omitted schedules.

action_items: Render an InsightsPanel on the principal dashboard, call /dashboard/insights, add ai-insights-panel, and show the four red/orange/yellow/green cards.
Persist/derive the intended class teacher on student complaints and scope teacher list/update queries to that teacher instead of every institute teacher.
Use enums/validation for complaint direction and status, rejecting transitions outside pending/under_review/resolved.
Fix timetable rendering so configured days/periods drive headers/rows and All Batches does not discard colliding batch entries.
Implement the required secure HttpOnly access-token cookie and explicit credentialed CORS origins, or formally revise the auth playbook if Bearer-only localStorage is intentional.
Apply the statutory salary breakdown consistently or explicitly validate configured structures against the required Basic/HRA rules.
Add the referenced branded UPI QR to fee receipts; the current fee_receipt drawing code renders itemization and balances but no QR.
Add DialogDescription or intentional aria-describedby handling to dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx contains no insights state, API request, component, or ai-insights-panel despite the implemented backend endpoint.
Complaints use only a direction string and never store/resolve a routed teacher ID; list_complaints therefore exposes every teacher/both complaint to every teacher in the tenant.
ComplaintUpdate.status is an unrestricted string and update_complaint writes it directly; ComplaintUpdate also declares note twice.
Timetable.jsx reduces all rows into grid[day][slot], guaranteeing cross-batch overwrites in the default All Batches view, and renders constant DAYS/SLOTS rather than generated values.
fee_receipt has no QR generation/drawing path despite the requested UPI QR and institute upi_id support.
server.py is 1971 lines and should be split into focused auth, academics, finance, complaints, dashboard, PDF, and seed modules; synchronous requests calls in async routes can block the event loop.

success_rate.backend: 60% (6/10 targeted tests passed; four intentional security/validation checks failed)
success_rate.frontend: 80% of requested end-to-end areas fully passed; Insights is missing and timetable rendering is incomplete

seed_data_creation: Regenerated the live timetable to 120 conflict-free slots. Temporary API/UI students, fees, salaries, and complaints were deleted. One uploaded TEST_UI_evidence.pdf storage record/object may remain orphaned because the product has no file-delete API; disposable lockout records were created for fake TEST_lockout_* identifiers.
test_credentials: Used principal, teacher1, teacher2, and discovered student STU26DDC67 with credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. /app/auth_testing.md is absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend final run: timetable, admission/move/teacher scope, fee+salary PDFs/default breakdown, Razorpay order, insights contract/RBAC, and role/bcrypt/lockout passed. Complaint teacher scoping, invalid status rejection, HttpOnly cookie, and credentialed CORS failed. UI verified 120-slot generation and PDF, admission/move with both counts refreshed, teacher's exact 9-student scope, multi-role complaint attachment+two audit entries, finance PDF actions, legal routes, and all role dashboards. The complaint created by UI was deleted directly afterward.
rca_of_the_issue: Insights is an unintegrated backend-only feature. Complaint privacy and state failures come from a direction-only data model plus unrestricted string fields. Timetable display loss comes from keying the UI grid by day/slot without batch dimension and using hardcoded dimensions. Cookie/CORS failures are explicit server configuration: login only returns JSON and CORSMiddleware sets allow_credentials=False.
